mapper.select: SELECT ID , ARTICLE_ID , EMAIL , CONTENT , RECOMMEND_CNT , DEL_YN , CRT_DT , MDFY_DT , FILE_SET_ID FROM REPLIES WHERE ARTICLE_ID = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT R.ID , R.ARTICLE_ID , R.EMAIL , R.CONTENT , R.RECOMMEND_CNT , R.DEL_YN , R.CRT_DT , R.MDFY_DT , F.ID AS FILE_SET_ID , F.EMAIL AS FILE_UPLOADER , F.CRT_DT AS FILE_UPLOAD_DATE , F.MDFY_DT AS FILE_MODIFY_DATE , F.FILE_ID , F.DISPLAY_FILE_NAME , F.OBFUSCATE_FILE_NAME , F.DOWNLOAD_COUNT , F.DEL_YN AS FILE_DEL_YN FROM REPLIES R LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT FS.ID , FS.EMAIL , TO_CHAR(FS.CRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CRT_DT , TO_CHAR(FS.MDFY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFY_DT , F.ID AS FILE_ID , F.DISPLAY_FILE_NAME , F.OBFUSCATE_FILE_NAME , F.FILE_SIZE , F.DOWNLOAD_COUNT , F.DEL_YN FROM FILE_SET FS INNER JOIN FILES F ON FS.ID = F.FILE_SET_ID WHERE F.DEL_YN = 'N') F ON R.FILE_SET_ID = F.ID WHERE R.ID = #{_parameter} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
